article.headline: MLB Proposes 154-Game Regular Season Plus Expanded Seven-Game Division Series Format
article.summary: Major League Baseball has submitted a proposal to the MLB Players Association to reduce the regular season to 154 games while restructuring the postseason.
article.body:
Major League Baseball’s latest proposal to the MLB Players Association seeks to overhaul the sport's structure by shortening the regular season to 154 games. This reduction aims to introduce a weekly off-day for players while establishing a new national broadcast window designed to showcase top teams and players, according to MLB spokesman Glen Caplin.

For fans, this change intends to minimize weekday afternoon games and create a platform for longer postseason series. The league suggests that a shorter regular season allows for a more significant October, characterized by an expansion of the Division Series from a best-of-five to a best-of-seven format. By modifying the schedule, the league states it can better feature the game's top pitchers on the postseason stage.

The proposal introduces significant shifts in playoff logistics, specifically regarding how opponents are selected. Under the plan, the top seeds in both the Wild Card and Division Series rounds would be granted the power to choose their opponents. In the Wild Card round, the No. 3 seed would select between the No. 5 or No. 6 seed. For the Division Series, the No. 1 seed would select which Wild Card winner they face after that round concludes. MLB expects this mechanism to amplify fan interest, heighten the importance of regular-season records, and fuel new rivalries.

While the league emphasizes player health and broadcast drama as primary drivers, industry analysis from MLB Trade Rumors suggests the focus remains on long-term financial goals, noting the increased revenue potential of expanded postseason broadcast rights. The proposal remains under consideration by the Players Association, with discussions ongoing regarding the impact on total games and the structure of the postseason calendar.

article.headline: Sun and warmth continue as temperatures surge into the lower 80s
article.summary: Expect sunny skies and highs reaching the lower 80s on Thursday in Louisville and throughout the week in Lexington.
article.body:
Sunshine will again dominate the forecast on Thursday as thermometers climb into the lower 80s accompanied by a gentle southwesterly breeze. While the region currently enjoys these mild conditions, clouds are expected to increase late Thursday night and into early Friday as a cold front approaches. According to WDRB, this pattern of 80s will stick around for a few more days before the remnants of tropical storm Isaias bring a soaking rain to the region late Saturday and Sunday.

For residents, the continued warmth offers an extended window of pleasant weather, though the shift in conditions by the weekend may impact outdoor plans. Those traveling or attending events in the Bluegrass area should also prepare for a consistent stretch of high 70s and low 80s throughout the week, as reported by Harness Racing Update. The stable, sunny outlook across these locations contrasts with the later arrival of tropical moisture.

In Louisville, nighttime temperatures are forecast to dip into the 50s. Cloud cover originating from a tropical cyclone in the Gulf will influence conditions by Friday, keeping highs generally in the lower 80s. The thickening cloud cover on Saturday serves as the precursor to the anticipated weekend rainfall. Staying informed on specific rainfall totals will be necessary as the weekend weather system develops and makes its full impact on the local forecast.

Looking ahead, the shift toward rain late Saturday and Sunday marks the end of the current period of settled, sunny weather. Forecasters advise keeping an eye on updates regarding the precipitation arriving from the tropical storm remnants.

article.headline: WNBA Scoring Machine Kelsey Mitchell Declares Intent To Be Selfish In Free Agency
article.summary: Free agent Kelsey Mitchell is weighing her future after recording a league-record 1,086 total points for the Indiana Fever this season.
article.body:
Kelsey Mitchell arrives at free agency following a career-best campaign where she set a WNBA record with 1,086 total points. Averaging 24.7 points per game, the 30-year-old guard also led the league with a 45% 3-point shooting percentage. As she prepares to navigate her first experience as an unrestricted free agent, Mitchell stated she plans to be selfish regarding her next career move, noting that she must prioritize what is best for her future after nine seasons with the same franchise.

This impending decision carries significant weight for the Indiana Fever organization, which views re-signing the four-time All-Star as a major priority. Teammate Caitlin Clark has publicly expressed a strong desire for Mitchell to remain in Indiana, citing the importance of their established backcourt chemistry. The two players navigated a high-pressure season together, enduring intense public scrutiny while forming an elite scoring duo.

Basketball Hall of Famer Shaquille O'Neal has weighed in on the situation, advising Mitchell to leverage the increased spotlight that comes with playing alongside a high-profile teammate like Clark. O'Neal suggested that staying within that orbit could offer professional and financial advantages, though he emphasized he would not interfere with her personal decision-making process.

Mitchell’s choice remains one of the most anticipated moves of the upcoming offseason. While the Fever possess the salary cap space necessary to retain her, competition from other organizations is expected to be fierce when free agency officially opens in late January.

article.headline: Hit Drama This City Is Ours Returns To BBC iPlayer October 25
article.summary: The second series of the award-winning crime drama debuts in full on BBC iPlayer on Sunday, 25 October.
article.body:
The first series of This City Is Ours drew an average of 6.2 million viewers, with the opening episode reaching over 8.3 million people after its initial launch. Almost three million viewers streamed the series finale ahead of its television transmission in May 2025, demonstrating the high level of audience engagement leading into the new season.

This upcoming release is vital for fans following the dramatic conclusion of the first series. The show, created by Stephen Butchard and produced by Left Bank Pictures, earned BAFTA Television Award nominations for Best Drama and Leading Actor. The renewal reflects the significant positive reception from the audience and continued support from BBC Drama.

According to the BBC, the second series follows Michael Kavanagh and Diana Williams as they are pulled into questions regarding Ricardo’s death shortly after arriving in Spain. In Liverpool, remaining gang members face mounting tensions alongside the arrival of Ozzie Thompson, an old-school gangster seeking compensation. The trailer features the return of James Nelson-Joyce as Michael Kavanagh, alongside new cast members Shaun Evans as Ozzie Thompson and Álvaro Morte as Felipe Guzman.

Following the full release on BBC iPlayer, the series will broadcast on BBC One at 9pm on Sunday and Monday nights beginning 25 October.

article.headline: British Covid cases surge 230 per cent as XFG strain spreads worldwide
article.summary: The XFG variant, known as the American strain, has driven a sharp increase in UK infections and hospital admissions since August.
article.body:
Patients diagnosed with the XFG variant frequently present with a characteristic hoarse, croaky voice that distinguishes it from previous iterations of the virus. While other symptoms remain consistent with earlier variants, such as sore throat, cough, fever, and loss of taste or smell, this specific vocal change serves as a common identifier for the strain first identified in January 2025. 

Understanding the behavior of XFG is essential for managing the current surge, as health authorities monitor rising transmission rates. The UK Health Security Agency reports that between August and September, infections in Britain climbed from 1,374 to 4,589, a 230 per cent increase. With hospitalizations rising by 15 per cent—and other data points suggesting even higher admission spikes—the strain is now considered the most common in North America and a significant factor in global circulation.

According to the UKHSA, the rise in infections is linked to waning population immunity roughly a year after the previous significant wave. Additionally, the shift toward colder, wetter weather has forced more people indoors, facilitating easier transmission. Experts state that the current Covid-19 vaccine is specifically engineered to target XFG and its related strains to provide protection against severe illness.

To curb the spread, the UKHSA advises individuals experiencing symptoms, such as high temperatures, to remain at home. Those unable to isolate are encouraged to wear well-fitting or surgical face masks in public, avoid crowded spaces, and practice stringent hygiene, including frequent handwashing. Vaccination efforts have currently prioritized those aged 75 and over, residents in care homes, and individuals with weakened immune systems.

news.og_title: Atmane's ugly and unsportsmanlike gesture that no one can understand
news.og_desc: Terence Atmane is characterized as a controversial tennis player, to say the least. The Frenchman, currently ranked number 99 in the world, has the qualities to be among the top 30 or 40 tennis players globally, but his mindset and off-court issues prevent him from achieving that. The latest example was witnessed in the Jingshan Challenger during his first-round match against Elias Ymer.Everything seemed to be under control for the Frenchman in a very close match where each had won a set. In fact, he was leading 5-3 in the final set and was serving to close the match, however, the Swedish player gradually turned the situation around. First, he broke back to make it 5-4, and then he equalized at 5-5.It was here that a very ugly and unsportsmanlike gesture from Atmane occurred, out of frustration for not having closed the match. When it was 5-5 and 30-15 for Ymer, a missed forehand by the Frenchman was the last straw, and he decided to retire from the match when he still had chances to win and everything was tied. The Swede was in disbelief when he saw him approaching the net to shake hands.Bon… eh bien Terence Atmane a juste lâchement abandonné en voyant que le match lui échappait… Ni combativité, ni fair-play, c’est impossible à défendre ça. https://t.co/RagPqVjCbf pic.twitter.com/ZqgzxwbqYy— Avantage Tennis 🎾 (@AvantageTennis_) September 30, 2026Atmane reached number 41 in the ATP ranking in April, but is now close to falling out of the Top 100Atmane is having a somewhat turbulent 2026. While he achieved his best ranking in the ATP in April (41st position), since then, he has faced very inconsistent results, as well as a split from his coach, Guillaume Peyre.The former coach stated that their separation was due to “a matter of behavior and attitude. I set certain foundations, certain values, and some things were not respected. At the moment something goes outside the framework I had established, I leave, and that's it. It is unacceptable for me. It is not a matter of tennis or results, because I was playing well. It is mainly a matter of human values and behavior.”

article.headline: إنذار أحمر: أمطار غزيرة ورياح عاتية تضرب مكة المكرمة اليوم الخميس
article.summary: أصدر المركز الوطني للأرصاد إنذارًا أحمر لمحافظتي رهاط ومدركة بمكة المكرمة حتى الثامنة مساءً بسبب الأمطار والرياح.
article.body:
تنبيهات شديدة اللهجة أطلقها المركز الوطني للأرصاد في السعودية، تزامناً مع رصد حالة جوية مضطربة تتركز في محافظتي رهاط ومدركة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. هذه الحالة الجوية المتوقعة، والمصنفة ضمن الإنذار الأحمر، تحمل في طياتها مخاطر متعددة تشمل الرياح شديدة السرعة، وهطول أمطار غزيرة، بالإضافة إلى تساقط البرد، وخطر جريان السيول، مع احتمالية حدوث صواعق رعدية تؤدي إلى انعدام في مدى الرؤية الأفقية.

تمثل هذه التحذيرات أهمية قصوى لسكان هذه المناطق والمسافرين عبرها، حيث يتوجب أخذ الحيطة والحذر نظراً لتأثيرات الطقس العنيفة على الطرق والأنشطة اليومية. إن توقعات الأرصاد لا تقتصر على الأمطار فقط، بل تمتد لتشمل تقلبات جوية حادة تتطلب متابعة دقيقة للنشرات الرسمية لضمان السلامة العامة خلال ساعات التأثير.

من ناحية أخرى، شهدت درجات الحرارة في مختلف مدن المملكة تفاوتاً ملحوظاً، حيث سجلت المدينة المنورة والدمام أعلى درجات حرارة عند 41 درجة مئوية، تليها مكة المكرمة بـ 40 درجة مئوية. وفي المقابل، سجلت أبها أدنى درجة حرارة عند 15 درجة مئوية، والباحة 17 درجة مئوية، فيما تراوحت درجات الحرارة في بقية المدن مثل جدة والرياض وجازان وحائل بين معدلاتها المعتادة لهذا الموسم.

من المقرر أن تستمر الحالة الجوية في محافظتي رهاط ومدركة حتى الساعة الثامنة من مساء اليوم الخميس، وفقاً لما نقله المركز الوطني للأرصاد عبر وكالة الأنباء السعودية "واس". يُنصح المواطنون والمقيمون بالبقاء على اطلاع مستمر بآخر تحديثات الأرصاد الجوية واتباع تعليمات الجهات المختصة في المناطق المتأثرة لتجنب المخاطر الناجمة عن السيول والرياح القوية.

news.og_title: مدرب الوكرة: تحضيراتنا لمواجهة الغرافة جيدة
news.og_desc: أكد التشيلي خوسيه لويس سييرا، مدرب الوكرة القطري، أن تحضيرات فريقه لاستئناف منافسات الدوري القطري تسير بصورة جيدة، مشيرًا إلى أن الاستعدادات خلال فترة التوقف لم تكن مرتبطة بمواجهة الغرافة فقط، وإنما شملت تجهيز الفريق لبقية مباريات الموسم. وأوضح سييرا أن طول فترة التوقف منح الجهاز الفني فرصة للعمل على عدد من الجوانب، إلى جانب الاستفادة من مباريات كأس QSL في تجهيز اللاعبين الذين لم يحصلوا على فرص مشاركة منتظمة خلال مباريات الدوري، بما يساعد على رفع جاهزيتهم الفنية والبدنية. ويستعد الوكرة لمواجهة الغرافة ضمن منافسات الجولة الخامسة من الدوري القطري، في مباراة يسعى خلالها الفريق إلى تحقيق نتيجة إيجابية ومواصلة مشواره في المسابقة. من جانبه، أبدى أيوب عسال، لاعب الوكرة، ثقته في قدرة فريقه على تحقيق الفوز أمام الغرافة، مؤكدًا أن المنافس يمتلك مجموعة من اللاعبين المميزين، إلا أن الوكرة يملك بدوره عناصر قادرة على تقديم المستوى المطلوب. وأشار عسال إلى أن الفريق سيبذل أقصى ما لديه داخل الملعب من أجل تحقيق هدفه وحصد النقاط، مؤكدًا جاهزية اللاعبين لخوض المواجهة المرتقبة.
